title: Y1DA--CON CTX 674-25-007 - Front Side Walk Repair Bldg. 204
agency_path: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.257-NETWORK CONTRACT OFFICE 17 (36C257)
detail_text: THIS IS A PRESOLICIATION NOTICE NOT A SOLICITATION. A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL WILL BE POSTED ON OR ABOUT March 1, 2026. The Central Texas Veterans Health Care System currently has a requirement for a project to repair and modify sidewalks for the safety of veterans entering the main entrance of building 204 at the Olin E. Teague Veterans Medical Center located at 1901 Veterans Memorial Drive, Temple, TX 76504. General Contractor shall provide all necessary labor, materials, equipment, and supervision to construct project Front sidewalk repair building 204 in accordance with all Contract Documents. All work shall be done in accordance with the SOW. The SOW will be posted with the solicitation. The NAICS code for this procurement is 238110 with a small business size standard of $19M. The magnitude of this project is between $100,000 and $250,000. This project will be 100% set-aside for Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses. The POC for this project will be Stephanie Ingersoll, stephanie.ingersoll@va.gov.
